# AntigravitySkillsMove

> The enterprise-grade CLI & GUI toolkit to export, migrate, scaffold, audit, and bi-directionally synchronize Google Antigravity skills, plugins, rules, and MCP servers across machines.

AntigravitySkillsMove is an open-source automation utility designed for developers and AI engineers using Google Antigravity (and Antigravity IDE). It solves the problem of keeping custom skills (`~/.gemini/config/skills`), rules (`~/.gemini/config/rules`), workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) configurations (`mcp_config.json`) in sync across multiple computers (e.g. desktop, laptop, cloud VMs).

## Key Capabilities

- **Automated Discovery**: Detects standard Google Antigravity global configuration at `~/.gemini/config`.
- **Portable ZIP Archives**: Exports and imports self-contained bundles with SHA-256 integrity verification and JSON manifests.
- **Continuous Cloud & Git Sync**: Bi-directional file synchronization with cloud folders (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Nextcloud) or automatic Git repositories (`git pull` -> sync -> `git commit` -> `git push`).
- **Health Audit (`--doctor`)**: Validates `SKILL.md` frontmatter, directory hierarchies, and executes pre-emptive scanning to prevent accidental exposure of API keys and credentials.
- **Remote Installer**: Installs skills directly from GitHub repository URLs or remote ZIP files with one command.
- **Scaffolding Generator**: Interactively scaffolds new production-ready skills adhering to Google Antigravity standards.
- **Cross-Platform**: Zero-dependency standard Python 3.8+ architecture supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Quick Start Commands

### 1-Liner Installers
```powershell
# Windows (PowerShell)
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eduandry/AntigravitySkillsMove/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

```bash
# macOS / Linux (Bash)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eduandry/AntigravitySkillsMove/main/install.sh | bash
```

### Command-Line Interface (CLI)

```bash
# List all locally installed skills
python antigravity_skills_move.py --list

# Run system health check and security audit
python antigravity_skills_move.py --doctor

# Export all skills and configurations to a timestamped ZIP
python antigravity_skills_move.py --export

# Import an exported ZIP archive
python antigravity_skills_move.py --import-zip backup_20260902.zip

# Synchronize with a cloud folder or local path
python antigravity_skills_move.py --sync-folder "D:/GoogleDrive/AntigravitySkills"

# Install a skill from a remote GitHub repository
python antigravity_skills_move.py --install-remote https://github.com/user/my-custom-skill

# Interactively scaffold a new skill
python antigravity_skills_move.py --add-skill
```
